rationale.oversight-explanation: Highlights uncertainty in AI code completions to help programmers judge output.
rationale.ai-review: Trained an edit model to predict which tokens require human edits.
rationale.built-system: Implemented a working interface prototype for the uncertainty highlighting.
rationale.assistive: Evaluates highlighting for inline AI code completions during human programming.
rationale.risk-quality: Measures whether highlighting improves the functional accuracy of programmer code.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Evaluates uncertainty highlighting as a mitigation against overreliance on AI.
rationale.method-experiment: Conducted a controlled study with randomized assignment to highlighting conditions.
rationale.method-self-report: Collected subjective feedback via interviews and TLX workload questionnaires.
